transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1180 Hickory Downs Drive?
Yeah, this is me at 1180 Hickory Downs Drive, just me and my partner here, water’s not in the house, and we’re both good — no need for help, not even a boat or truck, we’re totally fine.
Thanks for confirming you’re both safe and not needing help. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just the two of us here, no one else stuck inside or needing a hand—everything’s calm and dry, no water in the house at all.

Thanks for the update, staying safe is key. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, just me and my partner, both good to go, no one stuck or needing special help, and we’re totally dry inside—no water at all, so no worries.
You’re all set and dry inside—no one stuck or needing help. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just us two hanging out dry and safe, no need for a truck or boat or anything—everything’s good here.
You’re dry and safe, no need for help. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, I’m dry and safe, no need for help—just me and my partner here, no water inside, and we’re good. Unfortunately, no truck, boat, or spare seats to spare for anyone else.
You’re dry and safe, no need for help. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just me and my partner, dry as a bone, no water in the house yet, and we’re good to go, no need for no truck or boat or nothing.
You’re clear to stay put for now. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
